title: files.download result
description: companion → plugin, the payload of the `result` answering a `files.download`: where the file now is, relative to the workspace the companion's hello names, its size in bytes and its type. The bytes never ride the wire.

localPath.description: Relative to the workspace, with forward slashes: `conversations/<conversationId>/<attachmentId>-<name>` for an attachment, `files/<path>` for a Files path.
